---
name: Good first issue
about: Small, well-scoped task for a first-time contributor
title: "[good first issue] "
labels: good first issue, help wanted
---

**Why this is a good first issue**
- Touches docs, tests, or a small typed surface. No custody, mainnet, or grants.

**Task**

**Acceptance**
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run demo` passes if behavior or the demo changed
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior changes
- [ ] No secrets committed

**Pointers**
- How it works: README, "How it works"
- Policy reference: `docs/POLICY.md`
- Engine: `src/guard/` (policy, call flattening, stores); proxy: `src/proxy/`
